title: Consumer Court Awards Tracker: Refund & Compensation Orders
h1: Monthly Tracker of Consumer Commission Orders on Refunds and Compensation
metaTitle: Consumer Court Awards Tracker: Refund & Compensation Orders
metaDescription: A monthly roundup of consumer commission orders against e-commerce sites, airlines, banks and builders, with amounts and links.

awards.disputeSubject: Refurbished mobile delivered as brand new; return request closed unilaterally
awards.keyHolding: E-commerce marketplace cannot disown warranty and return liabilities by designating itself an intermediary under Section 79 IT Act when handling logistics, payments and commission.

awards.disputeSubject: Flight cancelled due to operational reason; forced credit shell refused, refund withheld
awards.keyHolding: Credit shell imposition without customer consent violates Supreme Court ruling in Pravasi Legal Cell and DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part II.

awards.disputeSubject: Unauthorised ATM cash debit skimming reported within 24 hours; bank denied liability
awards.keyHolding: Under RBI Zero Liability Circular 2017, the burden of proving customer negligence rests squarely on the bank once prompt notification is established.

awards.disputeSubject: 4-year possession delay in Noida residential project without valid force majeure excuse
awards.keyHolding: Allottee cannot be compelled to wait indefinitely for possession; Supreme Court in Pioneer Urban Land mandates complete refund with interest.

awards.disputeSubject: High-end laptop missing from delivery parcel; courier marked delivered with OTP
awards.keyHolding: Where unboxing evidence and prompt grievance registration create prima facie proof of missing contents, platform is strictly accountable under Section 2(47) CPA 2019.

awards.disputeSubject: Failed ATM transaction debit uncredited for 34 days; failure of auto-reversal TAT
awards.keyHolding: Breaching RBI Circular DPSS.CO.PD No.629 T+5 reversal deadline mandates auto-compensation of ₹100 per day without requiring separate legal action.

awards.disputeSubject: Luggage lost on international transit; delayed passenger without essential wear
awards.keyHolding: Air carrier cannot take shelter behind per-kg Warsaw/Montreal convention caps when passenger proves manifest negligence in baggage management.

awards.disputeSubject: Unilateral forfeiture of commercial shop earnest advance upon project stalling
awards.keyHolding: Forfeiture clauses exceeding 10% earnest money without proof of actual developer loss constitute unfair contracts under Section 2(46) Consumer Protection Act 2019.

dataSources: CONFONET / e-Jagriti National Consumer Disputes Redressal Portal
District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (DCDRC) certified daily order sheets
State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (SCDRC) appellate benches
National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) reported judgments
Official law reporting databases: SCC Online, LiveLaw, and Bar & Bench
selectionCriteria: Disputes involving company deficiency in service (Section 2(11)) or unfair trade practice (Section 2(47))
Final orders directing monetary refund, compensation, or statutory interest
Verified party names and authentic court docket numbers
Matters involving E-Commerce, Aviation, Banking/Fintech, or Real Estate corporations
methodology.verificationMethod: All orders are cross-referenced with public registry docket logs on e-Jagriti and verified against judicial sign-offs before indexing.
exclusionCriteria: Interim stay orders without final financial adjudication
Ex-parte orders where appeals remain pending under statutory stay
Unverified press hearsay without documented court case numbers
